name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
October 28, 2008
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Pack 751 Webelos Scout Den the Boltz will conduct a flag ceremony and Webelos Den Leader Tony Visco will give the invocation.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation declaring November 13, 2008, "The Great Southern California Shakeout" in the City of Vista. (CC)
P2.
Proclamation declaring November 2008 "National American Indian Heritage Month" and November 28, 2008, "Native American Day" in the City of Vista. (CC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Ordinances on Agenda (CC/BSD/CDC)
C3.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C4.
Second Reading of Ordinance (CC)
C5.
Youth Appointments to Commissions (CC)
1.
Waive the residency requirement for one student by a three-fifths majority vote in accordance with Vista Municipal Code Section 2.18.060B1; and
2.
Confirm the Mayor's appointments to the Youth Commission and youth representatives on City commissions as listed on Exhibit 1.
C6.
Purchase of Property at 1729 W. Vista Way (CC)
C7.
Thibodo Road Curb and Landscape Improvement Project (CC)
C8.
Nuisance Abatement Hearing for 1045 Alta Calle (CC)
C9.
Creek Restoration Grant Applications (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , endorsing the application for an Urban Streams Restoration Grant, determining the appropriate environmental impact document, conditionally accepting the grant, if offered, and designating the Contract Manager and Fiscal Agent; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving the application for the California River Parkways Grant Program under the Safe Drinking Water, Water Quality and Supply, Flood Control, River and Coastal Protection Bond Act of 2006 (Proposition 84), and authorizing the City Manager to execute the related documents.
C10.
Enhanced Vapor Recovery Phase II Upgrades Agreement (CC)
C11.
Land Acquisition - Purchase of 430 Vista Village Drive (CDC)
C12.
Brownfields Assessment and Cleanup Grants (CDC)
C13.
West Vista Way Projects - Amendments to Dokken Engineering Agreements (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving Amendment No. 1 for services on the West Vista Way Sewer Rehabilitation Project; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving Amendment No. 2 for services on the West Vista Way Widening Project.
C14.
Street Tree Trimming Services Agreement (CC)
C15.
Land Acquisition - Purchase of 306 S. Santa Fe Avenue (CDC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Daytime Curfew Ordinance (CC)
D2.
Fire and Resource Assessment Program (CC)
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Appeal of PC3-181, Alta Vista Drive Tentative Parcel Map (CC)
1.
Conduct a public hearing to receive testimony regarding a proposed Tentative Parcel Map to split two residential lots into four lots in the R-1 Zone at 1847 Alta Vista Drive and 1244 Eucalyptus Avenue; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving a Tentative Parcel Map to split two residential lots into four lots in the R-1 Zone at 1847Alta Vista Drive and 1244 Eucalyptus Avenue.
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
